rationale: Both Vadym and Tyler are hands-on Solidity developers building in the blockchain space, with complementary strengths: Vadym brings 16+ years of programming experience and a proven track record scaling crypto products (Trustee, BlockSoftLab) focused on user accessibility, while Tyler is actively building Web3 infrastructure at Pacific Bridge. They share the Solidity/Ethereum stack and could explore how infrastructure and developer tooling intersect with mainstream crypto adoption.
intro_message: Vadym Hrusha, meet Tyler Sehr — both Solidity developers in blockchain; Vadym's built consumer crypto products at scale while Tyler is building Web3 infrastructure, so you might compare notes on what developers and users actually need.
